recreation_brief: 1. Create a 16:9 slide with a plain white (#FFFFFF) background. 2. Draw the outer slide frame: a no-fill rectangle outline, ~2.5pt stroke in #CC0000, inset ~2% from all four slide edges. 3. Place the title: a centered text box spanning ~20-80% width at ~9-20% height containing 'Batch Data (Feature Vectors)' in Arial Bold ~40pt, solid #CC0000. 4. Place the slide-number badge: an oval at ~89-94% width and ~9-16% height, filled #FFFF00 with a ~1.5pt #CC0000 outline, containing '42' centered in Arial Bold ~14pt #CC0000. 5. Draw the content frame: a no-fill rectangle outline, ~2pt stroke in #0000CC, from ~7% to ~93% width and ~24% to ~95% height, enclosing all three diagram columns. 6. Place the left label box: a white-filled rectangle with a thin #CC0000 border at ~8-30% width and ~35-43% height; two centered lines in Arial Bold ~14pt: line 1 = 'Feature Vector of ' (#CC0000) + 'One' (#66CC00) + ' Input' (#CC0000); line 2 = 'Sample (Using ' (#CC0000) + 'one filter' (#0000CC) + ')' (#CC0000). 7. Build the left diagram at ~16-23% width and ~46-80% height: construct one 3D cube as a grouped shape (front face square #7CFC00, top face parallelogram #66CC00, right-side face parallelogram #4C9A00), then duplicate it into a vertical stack of 5 cubes (1 wide x 5 tall) with thin white gaps between cubes. 8. Place the middle label box: same white fill and thin #CC0000 border at ~34-62% width and ~35-43% height; two centered lines in Arial Bold ~14pt: line 1 = 'Feature Vectors of ' (#CC0000) + 'One' (#66CC00) + ' Input Sample' (#CC0000); line 2 = '(Using ' (#CC0000) + '4 filters' (#0000CC) + ')  ' (#CC0000) + '[4 Channels]' (#0000CC). 9. Build the middle diagram at ~39-54% width and ~44-78% height: tile the same green 3D cube into a 4-column x 5-row grid of 20 cubes viewed slightly from above, with thin white gaps. 10. Place the right label box: same white fill and thin #CC0000 border at ~65-92% width and ~29-42% height; three centered lines in Arial Bold ~14pt: line 1 = 'Feature Vectors of :' (#CC0000); line 2 = 'FIVE' (#66CC00, bold) + '  Input Samples  ' (#CC0000) + '[mini-Batch]' (#CC0000, bold); line 3 = 'Using ' (#CC0000) + '4 filters' (#0000CC) + ' ' (#CC0000) + '[4 Channels]' (#0000CC). 11. Build the right diagram at ~63-90% width and ~42-93% height: draw five 4-wide x 5-tall cube-grid layers using the same cube construction, colored front-to-back #CC00CC (magenta), #FFD700 (yellow), #FF7F00 (orange), #00A800 (green), #4477AA (blue); offset each successive layer up and to the right (oblique projection) and send it behind the previous layer so the front magenta layer overlaps the rest, leaving the top faces of the 4 rear layers and the right-side faces of the rearmost blue layer visible. 12. Add a small white/gray arrow in the gap between the magenta and yellow layers near the top of the block, pointing down-right (stacking/batch direction). 13. Add the vertical dimension marker: a #CC0000 double-headed vertical arrow at ~63-66% width and ~55-85% height, left of the magenta layer and spanning its full height, with the label 'Feature Vector' in Arial Bold ~11-12pt #CC0000 rotated 90 degrees (reading bottom-to-top) alongside the arrow. 14. Add the horizontal dimension marker: a #CC0000 double-headed horizontal arrow at ~66-82% width and ~88-93% height, beneath the magenta layer and spanning its width, with 'Channels' and '(4 Filters)' stacked in Arial Bold ~11-12pt #CC0000 centered beneath the arrow. 15. Add the diagonal dimension marker: a #CC0000 double-headed diagonal arrow at ~84-92% width and ~60-90% height, running lower-left to upper-right parallel to the depth direction, with 'Batch size' and '(5 samples)' in Arial Bold ~11-12pt #CC0000 rotated diagonally alongside the arrow. 16. Do NOT render the solid black bar overlapping the bottom-left edge (~0-40% width, ~96-100% height) or the tiny red dash at the top-left of the frame (~0-2% width, ~0-2% height) - both are video-player artifacts, not slide content.
